tips.text: Farm normal Shrine Defense, not Steel Path; the Steel Path Oni takes three to four times as long for only 25% more pearls.
Run until drops fill most of the set, then buy only the missing parts with pearls, so a duplicate drop never wastes them.
Hold the offerings through the Extermination stage and insert them the moment the Oni goes invulnerable.
Destroy the Undying Flyers' pods; they pause the offering timer.
Skip Resource Boosters here; Fate Pearls are an end-of-mission reward and boosters do nothing for them.
Bring a nuke frame such as Mirage, Nova, Protea, Wisp or Mesa; a focused squad clears in 1:30 to 2 minutes.
Most players call it tedious but fast, often done in one or two evenings with the pity shop barely needed.
